About the Position

The University of Edinburgh Doctoral College (EDC) Scholarships provide fully funded PhD opportunities for UK and international students. Approximately 26 awards across various academic schools, covering full tuition fees and a tax-free living stipend equivalent to the UKRI minimum rate (£21,805 (2026/27 UKRI minimum)/year for 2025-26). Duration 3.5 to 4 years full-time (pro-rata part-time).

Financial Coverage

  • Full tuition fee coverage including international rates.
  • Annual tax-free stipend (£21,805 (2026/27 UKRI minimum)/year for 2025-26; rates increase annually).
  • Duration: 3.5-4 years full-time.
  • Access to professional development training.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Hold or expect to obtain UK First Class or Upper Second Class (2:1) Honours degree or international equivalent.
  • Must have applied for admission to a first-year full-time or part-time PhD at University of Edinburgh.
  • Meet English language entry requirements (IELTS/TOEFL can be submitted after application).
  • Generally not for those already holding a PhD or equivalent.
  • Merit-based; encourages applications from underrepresented groups.

Application Process

  1. Submit PhD admission application to University of Edinburgh.
  2. Wait up to 5 working days for system checks and receive University User Name (UUN).
  3. Log in to MyEd/EUCLID and complete the online EDC Scholarship application.
  • Special rules: School of Informatics and School of Physics and Astronomy assess automatically; School of Biological Sciences requires direct application.

School-Specific Quotas (Approx 26 Total)

Biological Sciences 1, Business School 1, Chemistry 1, Divinity 1, Economics 1, Edinburgh College of Art 1, Engineering 1, Geosciences 3, Health in Social Sciences 1, History Classics Archaeology 1, Informatics 1, Law 1, Literatures Languages Cultures 1, Mathematics 1, Moray House 1, Philosophy Psychology Language Sciences 1, Physics and Astronomy 1, Social and Political Science 1, College of Medicine & Veterinary Medicine 6.

Official Link

  • Scholarship page: https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/other-funding/doctoral-college
  • Admissions: https://www.ed.ac.uk/studying/postgraduate
  • Student Portal: https://www.myed.ed.ac.uk

Important Notes

  • Funding for Academic Year 2027/2028 not yet confirmed; check official portal.
  • Cannot be held concurrently with another fully-funded scholarship.
  • Business School special rule: 4-year funding only for Integrated PhD; standard 3-year PhD gets 3.5 years EDC + 6 months Business School funding.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

About the University of Edinburgh

University of Edinburgh is a public research university in Scotland's capital and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across medicine, science, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its research community supports collaboration across disciplines, connecting academic inquiry with challenges affecting health, technology and society.

Official website: https://www.ed.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Check official portal for upcoming deadlines. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
